A letter from your 5th Std gurl 💌

There's a little letter tucked away just for you. Open the envelope to read it.

A LETTER FROM YOUR 5TH STANDARD GIRL TO YOU ❤️

Hey you!

Do you remember September 1? That's when our little friendship journey started. And look at us now, November 17 already! It's been 77 days of knowing each other, creating memories, sharing silly moments and slowly becoming an important part of each other's lives.

Who knew that a simple beginning would turn into something this special?

You always see me as that little 5th-standard girl, someone you want to protect, care for and keep close. I know how much you care about me, how possessive you get sometimes and how you always make sure I feel special.

You once described me as your forever love. You placed me right after your mother, and somewhere in your imagination, you even started picturing me as your girlfriend and future partner.

I don't know whether you realise how much those little things mean to me, but trust me, I remember them.

There's something you probably haven't noticed. You always observe me, but you never notice when I'm observing you.

You don't notice how my eyes search for you whenever you're around. You don't notice how I look for you in a crowd or how I miss you when you're not beside me. Sometimes, I silently observe you while you have absolutely no idea that I'm looking at you.

And do you know something? I blush whenever you say "Love you." You've said it twice now, and those two little words still make me feel things I cannot properly explain. Maybe you don't see that side of me, but there's a little smile on my face every time I remember them. ❤️

But there's something I want you to understand.

I'm scared. Not because I don't value you or your feelings, but because I never want to become the reason behind your sadness. I don't want to hurt someone who has given me so much care and affection.

I don't want to rush into something just because it sounds beautiful. I want to understand my feelings, understand you and make sure that whatever happens between us is genuine.

So please, let me take my time. Let me slowly bring my feelings out of aeroplane mode. Maybe my heart is still learning how to express everything that it quietly feels.

And about your forever dreams...

I genuinely hope that one day you win your way into my considerations. If you do, I'm sure I'll give that place in my life the meaning it deserves. I cannot promise you an answer today, but I can tell you that I hope our story has a beautiful future.

I hope September 1 becomes a date we remember forever. I hope November 17 is just another little milestone in a much longer journey.

I hope we continue choosing this friendship, understanding each other, growing together and collecting memories. And who knows? Maybe someday we'll look back at this letter and smile at how everything started.

Thank you for being so caring, for remembering the smallest things about me, for your endless affection, your silly possessiveness and for making me feel special in ways you probably don't even realise.

Thank you for seeing me as your little 5th-standard girl even when I'm growing up. Thank you for imagining a future with me, even when I haven't figured out how to respond to all those dreams yet.

And one last thing...

You might think you're the only one who notices me, but remember, your little Momo notices you too. Maybe more than you think.

Here's to September 1, November 17 and all the beautiful days waiting ahead of us.

With lots of unspoken feelings, little blushes and a heart that's slowly coming out of aeroplane mode...

Yours,
YOUR MOMO ❤️
